snippet.title: Sky Races - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Your focus is to compete with other airplanes as quickly as possible and push them to the next level. The game is very immersive, engaging, and fun, and you will find yourself playing, again and again, all the time.

If you want to test your prowess against your friends, this is the right way to do it. Check out Sky Races right now and immerse yourself in the most exciting airplane race game ever!

Developed by Gametry
Also released on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch

#ps4 #playstation4 #skyraces #gametry #airplaneracecreator #theforeseenarcade 

FUN FACT: Sky Races is not an original game, but really Airplane Race Creator, a ready-to-publish airplane racing game template, designed and licensed by developer Target Studio.

Released November 12th 2021, Sky Races would be the third time the template was published on the Switch, following Air Racers on November 1st, and Air Stunt Racing on November 5th. The latter two are not released on PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, but anyone that watches streams by @TheNegativeIon on Twitch or YouTube, you might recognize various assets were also used for Hovercars 3077: Underground, a low-budget Steam game he played at one point. Needless to say, he was not impressed with the game, as he gave it a score of 2/10 in his review on InfiniteBacklog.

https://infinitebacklog.net/users/thenegativeion/reviews/hovercars-3077-underground-racing
